messages:
Ellie: CS-> escalate: Greenline Clinics reporting intermittent 503s and streaming disconnects on /v1/chat.generate starting ~2025-07-12T11:07:03Z. They report ~30-40% errors and client retries. Pasting sample logs.
ops-bot: alert: hosted-api/5xx p95 spike id: alert-1705009999 https://internal.redwood/alerts/1705009999
Maria: oncall, starting warroom. tagging runtime+infra. @Samir @AJ please join. I'll lead.
Samir: joining. Ellie, share a failing request and auth header redacted.
Ellie: sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat.generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-greenline-..." \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"healthcheck"}], "stream":true}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\n{"error":"upstream read timeout","detail":"stream closed"}
```
AJ: ingress shows `upstream reset` and `503` across multiple AZs. auth-proxy logs show repeated `token refresh failed (429)` between 11:06:40-11:08:00.
Maria: metrics: tenant=greenline token-refresh rate spiked x9 at 11:06:45; concurrent streaming sessions spiked x5. Cloud KMS emitted transient 429s at 11:06:44.
Samir: hypothesis: token refresh storm (client SDKs retry in lockstep after KMS 429) -> auth-proxy overload -> connection pool exhaustion -> 503s and stream terminations.
Kevin: customer impact summary for CS: Greenline says poor user experience for ~18 minutes, multiple clinicians affected. CS wants ETA and mitigation details.
Ellie: told customer warroom active; they asked about a temporary mitigation like routing to dedicated pool.
AJ: immediate mitigations:
- apply tenant circuit-breaker: cap concurrent streams to 45 for tenant=greenline
- enable best-effort non-stream fallback path for new requests
- bump auth-proxy queue size +20% (hotfix)
I'll canary these in 2m.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy/backoff-jitter v3.0-canary (deploy-1705009999-a)
ops-bot: tenant circuit-breaker applied for tenant=greenline concurrent_streams_limit=45
AJ: canary started. initial canary logs show backoff kicking in; token refresh retries now include jitter.
Maria: early signals: canary shard 5xx for tenant down from 38% -> 8%. Cluster p95 5xx down 35%.
Samir: tracing shows Greenline uses older SDK that retries token refresh with constant tiny backoff -> synchronized retry bursts when KMS returns 429.
Kevin: longer-term asks?
AJ: short-term fixes: ship auth-proxy default backoff+jitter, per-tenant refresh caps, connection pool safety. Long-term: recommend SDK update with jitter, and add "reserve capacity" knob for customers.
Samir: postmortem ownership assigned to Samir. I'll do RCA and action items.
Ellie: CS note drafted: apology + summary (throttle + fallback + auth-proxy patch) + ETA for permanent fix 48h. Sending now.
Maria: action items & owners:
- add jitter+exponential backoff in auth-proxy (AJ) - 6h
- per-tenant refresh caps + stronger circuit-breaker defaults (Samir) - 24h
- dashboard + alert for token-refresh 429 per-tenant (Maria) - 12h
- SDK guidance + customer comms package (DevEx + CS) (Ellie) - 48h
- increase streaming conn_pool autoscale thresholds (Infra) (Maria) - 24h
- chaos test to simulate KMS 429s (Samir) - 72h
AJ: PR opened: git.redwood/auth-proxy!678 - adds jitter + min backoff 200ms. Canary passing.
deploy-bot: canary passed -> rolling to 50% (deploy-1705009999-b)
ops-bot: 5xx rate for tenant=greenline down to 2.5% after rollouts. Some long-lived streams may still reconnect.
Kevin: product asked to add "emergency reserve" per-tenant routing to reserved capacity; adding to roadmap.
Samir: postmortem draft due by EOD tomorrow; will include timeline, RCA, remediation, and follow-ups.
Maria: closing warroom; reopen if 5xx > 5% sustained. Follow-up sync scheduled: https://meet.redwood/incident-1705009999 tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Ellie: sending customer update now. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: warroom closed by Maria at 1705010500
